title: Partner LLM Integrations
summary: This module provides interfaces and utilities for integrating with various partner-specific Large Language Models (LLMs), including Anthropic, Groq, HuggingFace, Mistral AI, Ollama, and OpenAI, handling message conversion, tool calling, and prompt caching.

nodes.label: Base Language Models
nodes.title: Base Language Models
nodes.description: Defines the foundational interfaces and abstract classes for all language models within the system, including LLMs and chat models.

nodes.label: Anthropic LLM
nodes.title: AnthropicLLM
nodes.description: A legacy LLM class for interacting with Anthropic's text completion API, handling prompt formatting and streaming.

nodes.label: HuggingFace Chat Model
nodes.title: ChatHuggingFace
nodes.description: A chat model wrapper for various Hugging Face LLMs (Endpoint, Hub, Pipeline, TextGenInference), providing a unified interface for chat interactions, streaming, and tool binding.

nodes.label: Ollama LLM
nodes.title: OllamaLLM
nodes.description: An LLM class for interacting with Ollama models, supporting various generation parameters, streaming, and reasoning modes.

nodes.label: ChatGPT Codex
nodes.title: ChatGPT-Authenticated Codex Chat Model
nodes.description: An experimental ChatOpenAI variant that routes requests to the ChatGPT Codex backend, authenticated via OAuth. It forces specific wire-level fields and handles system prompts by lifting them into the top-level 'instructions' field.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Chat Model
nodes.title: OpenRouter Chat Model Integration
nodes.description: Integrates with the OpenRouter API, providing access to various chat models. It handles API key management, request parameters, streaming, and structured output binding.

nodes.label: Message Handling
nodes.title: Message Handling
nodes.description: Manages the creation, translation, and utility operations for various message types used in language model interactions.

nodes.label: Anthropic Tool Conversion
nodes.title: Anthropic Tool Conversion
nodes.description: Functions to convert XML tool definitions into a format usable by Anthropic models and generate system messages for tool descriptions.

nodes.label: Groq Message Conversion
nodes.title: Groq Message Conversion
nodes.description: Utility functions for converting message chunks and full messages between Groq's API format and LangChain's BaseMessage types, handling tool calls and usage metadata.

nodes.label: Mistral OpenAI Format Conversion
nodes.title: Mistral OpenAI Format Conversion
nodes.description: Converts output schemas into an OpenAI-compatible response format for Mistral AI models, supporting JSON schema and function calling.

nodes.label: Output Parsers
nodes.title: Output Parsers
nodes.description: Provides tools for parsing and structuring the raw output from language models into more usable formats, such as lists, JSON, or Pydantic objects.

nodes.label: OpenAI Moderation Middleware
nodes.title: OpenAI Moderation for Agent Traffic
nodes.description: A middleware that moderates agent traffic (user input, model output, tool results) using OpenAI's moderation endpoint. It can be configured to error, end, or replace content upon violation.

nodes.label: ChatGPT OAuth Login
nodes.title: ChatGPT OAuth Login (Browser)
nodes.description: Initiates the ChatGPT OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, starting a local callback server and optionally opening a browser for user authentication. It persists the obtained tokens for subsequent use.

nodes.label: Custom Tool Decorator
nodes.title: Decorator for Custom OpenAI Tools
nodes.description: A decorator that transforms a Python function into a custom OpenAI tool, allowing for metadata and schema definition. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous functions.

groups.label: LLM Providers
groups.title: LLM Providers
groups.description: Integrations with various third-party Large Language Model services.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Core Abstractions
groups.description: Foundational interfaces and utilities for language model interaction.

groups.label: Utility Components
groups.title: Utility Components
groups.description: Helper functions and middleware for enhancing LLM interactions, including authentication and moderation.
